algorithm.ordering: Ascending immutable UUID primary key. First page after last selected ID; wrap only if the forward page is empty. Never two nonempty batches in one invocation.
algorithm.cursor_validation: Version 1 object with exact allowed keys and null/canonical UUID after_id. Missing/malformed/unknown state refuses without repair/reset.
algorithm.lock_order: Existing pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(zoi.run_maintenance,0)), then fixed cursor row FOR UPDATE, then per-ID listing locks. Migration uses the same advisory gate and refuses current maintenance work.
algorithm.rows: Correlated primary-key LATERAL lookup with SKIP LOCKED for each bounded ID. Row/profile computation occurs only after selection.
algorithm.transaction: Cursor, scores, actual trigger effects and audit share one transaction. Any error rolls all back.
algorithm.fairness: No-op batches advance. Deleted cursor IDs do not break seeks. Insertions behind cursor and temporarily locked rows are revisited on wrap. A continually locked row can remain deferred until its owner transaction permits progress.
algorithm.lag: At unchanged six invocations/hour, stable N listings require ceil(N/1000) successful invocations for a full pass. This intentionally bounds work; no unmeasured production pass-time claim.
